literature_notes: Both ledger clips (L1, L2) describe a CSF2RB-GFP fusion deployed as a protein-stability reporter whose readout is the GFP/mCherry fluorescence ratio by flow cytometry. This is a canonical C-terminal fusion design: GFP is appended after the last residue of CSF2RB (residue 897), which falls squarely in the intracellular domain (topology 466–897). Neither clip names a residue position for the junction, and neither describes surface-display of GFP or an extracellular epitope. The topology_derived rule (assign the sole extracellular terminus when position is unstated) does not apply here because the protein-stability-reporter context makes intracellular C-terminal placement the only well-supported reading. CSF2RB has exactly one extracellular terminus (mature N-terminus after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 16), but no clip grounds a tag there. No ledger line supports an extracellular surface-tag insertion at any residue or loop of CSF2RB; sites = [] is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: CSF2RB is fused in-frame to GFP as a protein-stability reporter; the C-terminus (residue 897) lies in the intracellular domain (466–897), so GFP is on the cytoplasmic face, not the cell surface.
